Settings.Title: Camera zoom
Settings.EnablePatch: Enable mod (requires mod reload if changed)
Settings.ApplyWhenEnteringGlobalMap: Apply when entering the global map
Settings.BagOfTricksHint: If Bag of Tricks Camera Zoom Unlocked is enabled, disable it so the mods do not fight over the camera.
Settings.ApplyNowHint: On the global map the FOV is applied immediately; on the local map the zoom limits are refreshed.
Settings.LogDiagnostics: Write diagnostic messages to the log
